title: Capacity Planning
selectProject: Select a project to view its capacity plans.

create.title: New Capacity Plan
create.noReleasesLeft: Every release in this project already has a plan.
create.unitFixedHint: The unit cannot be changed after the plan is created — every number on the plan uses it.
create.createFailed: Failed to create the capacity plan

detail.noTeams: No teams on this plan yet. Add one to start entering capacity.

row.capacityInvalid: Capacity must be a number of zero or more
row.allocationRemoveFailed: Could not remove the Feature from the plan
row.allocatedFrom: Owned by {{team}}, allocated to this team

tiers.allocatedHint: From committed allocations on this plan
tiers.preliminaryHint: From the preliminary T-shirt size, mapped by workspace settings
tiers.heading: Estimate

allocate.title: Allocate to Teams
allocate.defaultHint: Blank uses the Feature’s refined estimate, or its preliminary size — never the total already allocated.
allocate.valueHint: Leave blank to assign without allocating: the plan charges this Feature’s own estimate to the team.
allocate.teamRequired: Choose a team for each allocation
allocate.removeRow: Remove this team from the allocation

warnings.team_missing_capacity: No capacity entered for this team, so its capacity checks cannot run

breakdown.title: Capacity breakdown
breakdown.subtitle: Complete, Rollup and Estimated against each team’s capacity, in {{unit}}.
breakdown.noTeams: Add a team to see a breakdown.

forecast.title: Calculate capacity forecast
forecast.subtitle: Proposes a capacity for {{team}} — sampled from its accepted work in finished iterations, or from a velocity you supply.
forecast.availabilityHint: 100% is the team as it has recently been — 200% if it doubled, 50% if it halved.

complexity.minor_concerns: Somewhat new or unclear — minor concerns (−10%)
complexity.major_concerns: Somewhat new or unclear — major concerns (−25%)

forecast.basis: From {{iterations}} finished iterations over {{days}} days, modelled as {{modelled}} iterations of this plan’s window.

insufficient.no_history: This team has not finished an iteration yet, so there is nothing to sample. Enter a capacity by hand for now.
insufficient.too_little_history: Less than 14 days of history — too little to forecast from. Enter a capacity by hand, or wait for the current iteration to finish.
insufficient.no_window: This plan has no planned start and end dates, so there is no window to forecast into. Add the dates first.
insufficient.no_cadence: This project runs no iterations with dates, so a velocity per iteration cannot be spread over the plan’s window. Add iteration dates, or enter a capacity by hand.

forecast.velocityHint: Leave empty to sample this team’s own finished iterations. Enter a number to propose capacity from a velocity you supply.
forecast.velocityInvalid: Enter a velocity above 0, or leave it empty
forecast.suppliedBasis: From the velocity you supplied, modelled as {{modelled}} iterations of this plan’s window. All three lines match because one number carries no spread.

publish.title: Publish this plan
publish.explain: Publishing makes the plan visible to everyone, not just planners.
publish.willWrite: Each Feature assigned to a team takes this plan’s planned start and end dates.
publish.releaseRule: The Release is written only when the plan’s window falls inside its release.
publish.revertWarning: Reverting later does NOT undo these field values — they must be cleared by hand.

skipReason.unallocated: no team assigned, so there was no plan for it to take
skipReason.release_span_mismatch: the plan’s window reaches outside its release, so the dates were written but the Release was not
skipReason.archived: it is archived, so the plan had nothing to write to — remove it from the plan or unarchive it
skipReason.other_release: it already belongs to another release, so its Release was left alone — the planned dates were still written

revert.title: Unpublish this plan?
revert.message: The plan becomes editable and planner-only again. The Release and planned dates already written onto Features are NOT undone — clear those by hand if you need to.
revert.done: Unpublished. Feature fields were left as they are.

summary.unassignedWarning: {{count}} Feature has no team in this plan
summary.unassignedWarning_plural: {{count}} Features have no team in this plan

items.empty: Add a Feature to see it here.
items.assignmentsCleared: {{item}} is unassigned but still on the plan
items.assignFailed: Could not change the planned team

delete.title: Delete capacity plans?
delete.bulkMessage: Delete {{count}} selected plan(s)? Teams and allocations on them go too.
delete.planMessage: The plan, its teams and every allocation on it are removed. This cannot be undone.
delete.publishedWarning: This plan is PUBLISHED. Deleting it removes the plan, its teams and every allocation, but the Release and planned dates it wrote onto its Features stay on those Features — revert the plan first if you want those undone.
delete.bulkPublishedMessage: Delete {{count}} selected plan(s)? {{published}} of them is published — deleting removes the plan, its teams and every allocation, but the Release and planned dates it wrote onto its Features stay on those Features.

edit.title: Edit Plan Details
edit.unitFixedHint: Unit and release are fixed: every number on the plan is expressed in the unit and scoped to the release.

teams.title: Add / Remove Teams on this plan

move.title: Move To Another Plan
move.noPlans: No other plan in this project
move.updateRelease: Update the Release to match the selected plan
move.releaseRequired: Required: this Feature belongs to another release, so the move needs it.
move.pickPlan: Choose the plan to move it to
move.movedParked: {{item}} moved to {{plan}}, unassigned — its teams are not on that plan
